scope: Correctness of coupled forward-playback source cue export and bounded source-to-representative binding accounting. Uncommitted C4R/S/T predecessors remain separately scoped; not photographic approval, universal lossless transport or stable 60 FPS.

mechanisms.bug: A forward backlog above ten ticks was classified as replay in run_coupled_stateful.
mechanisms.before: is_live_advance(last,target) requires target-last<=10; the whole bounded advance suppresses host output even though event links/particles still advance.
mechanisms.fix: Coupled advancing frames require non-backward target and existing synchronization/history guards, without the ten-tick distance heuristic. Explicit output_suppress_through boundaries still silence reconstructed ticks. Coupled homing arrival parameters also respect the per-tick boundary.
mechanisms.proof: Native production-loop regression: request tick90 with unchanged four-tick submissions and drain bounded output rings after each submission. Old code exports[] instead of parent death(4,1) and child birth(4,12); final exports each once. Pause silent, seek/reconstruction through90 silent, genuine burst after boundary exports at92, restart exports fresh once; replay/restart particle snapshots equal live fixture.

mechanisms.bug: Fresh unobserved trail storage at joint particle tick0 was classified as history replay if first activation arrived at a nonzero clock.
mechanisms.interim_failure: After first fix, low native run has13 main_break and13 bound intents, but only12 launch cues. Missing clip fd01c is recorded; checker rejects it.
mechanisms.fix: Recognize initially unobserved history at joint tick0 for live classification only. Preserve existing clear/restore/record behavior, nonzero-history/rewind/desynchronization guards and epoch suppression.
mechanisms.proof: Native real-trail observer regression first renders tick1, without a paused tick-zero frame. Interim code returns no launch record; final returns tick1/epoch5/count1.

historical_link: C4T medium close accepted12 flashes without a reported realization rejection and sampled1.1s encoding lag. Its source stages were not traced, so no exact retrospective causal attribution is claimed. The first regression proves a suppression mechanism consistent with that failure; historical record is retained, not rewritten.

diagnostics.binding: Constant-size cumulative source_packets_seen/non_particle/missing_root/epoch_mismatch/unbound/bound counters complement scan drops, binding_invalid, stale/duplicate and realization outcomes. Binding-disabled packets are outside the scan.
diagnostics.host_report: At most256 aggregate source-route keys, counts/first+last tick/root-clock delivery age and omitted-key-message count. No per-particle host mirror or new GPU readback. Current show uses37 keys; counts of other unbound output families are descriptive, not a complete source-generation proof.
diagnostics.conservation: Independent report reader observes13 launch and13 main_break messages;13 main_break intents bind. Packets offered equal classifications+scan drops; bound intents equal accepted+explicit rejection/stale/duplicate totals. All final stage-error/expiry/omission counts zero; low budget drops2 are explicit.
diagnostics.timestamps: Occurrence root time/position and pulse duration unchanged; late pulses may still expire. Source age is not display/GPU completion latency.

limits.unchanged: CatchupPacer, per-quality tick caps,32-tick output rings, particle capture/output caps, async callback transport, representative limits8/4/2 and OIT128MiB guard. No blocking readbacks in production.
limits.qualification: Test drains after four ticks/submission; no proof against ring overwrite when output-producing submissions/callback gaps exceed retention. Arbitrary each-event/gameplay-lossless transport and earlier untraced historical loss remain unqualified.
limits.legacy: Independent non-routed legacy homing retains its existing distance heuristic; this fix applies to the coupled event/trail/domain path.
limits.performance: Live backlog now legitimately performs formerly skipped output exports. No isolated cost or whole-host pacing improvement claimed.
